verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac is a robotics simulation, learning and ROS acceleration platform, not an AI agent or assistant that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The 'agent-ready' framing and the shipped agent skills are packages meant for external coding agents to use. Nothing in the pack shows Isaac itself connecting to MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
